svg.aria-label: LoanLens AI. FINTECH · AI HACKATHON 2026. Upload a loan agreement as a PDF or image. It extracts the text, flags risky clauses, estimates the effective APR, scores the loan's health and suggests what to negotiate. The LLM returns schema-validated JSON; past scans are stored in SQLite. Tech: Node.js, Express, SQLite, Gemini, REST API
